data.title: How LLNL is using AI, robotics and automation to accelerate advanced manufacturing
data.description: Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) scientists and engineers, in conjunction with the Department of Energy (DOE) and National Nuclear Security Administration (NNSA), are increasingly looking to AI, robotics and automation to help accelerate advanced manufacturing, materials discovery and experimental science. The work is part of a broader push to move faster from concept to deployment in mission-relevant technologies.
